vampire.name: Vampire
vampire.short: Every night you pick a victim.
vampire.description: Each night you and the other vampires agree on one villager. By day you hide who you are. You win when vampires equal the number of living villagers.

villager.name: Villager
villager.description: You have no special ability. Your weapons are your voice by day and your vote. The village wins when every vampire is hanged.

seer.name: Seer
seer.short: Each night you read one identity.
seer.description: Each night you pick a player and learn whether they are a vampire. When to speak up is your call — a seer who talks early dies early.

doctor.name: Doctor
doctor.description: Each night you shield one player from the vampire attack. You may protect yourself, but never the same person two nights in a row.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.short: If you die, you take someone with you.
hunter.description: However you die — night attack or hanging — you fire one last shot, and the player you choose dies too.
